listings.thesis: HBM/DRAM tightness links directly to AI accelerator supply, but memory cycles and capex timing are major risks.

priorCase.rankRationale: Winbond Electronics should hold because HBM, server DRAM and AI eSSD supply remains relevant, but current rank 78, 69.6% YTD, $23.1B market cap, valuation discovery or execution risk already captures much of the upside.
